newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Premium sees '97 net above '96.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Premium sees '97 net above '96.

text.p: Atlantic Premium Brands Ltd, which distributes food and non-alcoholic beverage products, said Tuesday it expects a significant increase in 1997 earnings compared with 1996.
"Heading into the stronger half of our fiscal year, we are confident that 1997 earnings will significantly eclipse our strong 1996 performance," Alan Sussna, president, said in a statement.
In 1996, Atlantic Beverage had operating earnings of $0.17 a share on sales of $153.3 million.
Earlier, it reported earnings for the second quarter of $0.05 a share on sales of $42.7 million, compared with year-ago earnings of $0.03 a share on sales of $37.0 million.

"The dramatic improvement in our second quarter earnings clearly shows that the new corporate growth strategy we adopted last year is working," Sussna said. "We nearly doubled our net income despite unfavorable raw material markets that hampered Grogan's and Richard's divisions, and the bad weather in April and May which affected our Beverage division."
